page.overview:
Who is Llyud?

Llyud is a group leader in command of an Esper Troupe of his own in Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. He is a flying unit who is met soon after Vaan and friends venture out to Lemurés. He first appears as a guest party member, but soon joins permanently. Llyud can equip spears and types of amulets and medallions for armor. His status-protection accessory protects against Confuse and his support ability accessory grants Auto-Float to his group.

Llyud has average stats though he excels in high Vitality, bested only by Ba'Gamnan and Basch. He has good attack power and Speed, but lacks in the magickal attributes.

Llyud's job is Dragoon, which grants him support abilities as well as attacks. Being an aerial unit, Llyud can move across obstacles and gaps on the battlefields. His Quickening, Fanfare, boosts all currently summoned ally Yarhi by giving them an extra level. It is obtained by defeating Hashmal.
